summary: Connection-reuse + protocol-mismatch causing elevated 5xx and runtime exits for dedicated tenant
description: Customer (SourceWave Labs, dedicated) reported a sustained increase in 5xx responses over a 3 hour window. Errors correlated with short-lived spikes in upstream runtime process exits and high connection-reset rates at the API gateway. Initial front-line triage indicated the failures were not typical OOMs; instead, runtime coredumps showed assertion failures in request-parsing paths tied to reused connections.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Send a burst of concurrent short streaming requests from a single tenant using persistent keepalive connections (HTTP/1.1 from CDN to API gateway, internal proxy translation to HTTP/2 to runtime).
2) Enable aggressive connection reuse (connection pool size 5, keepalive idle 60s) and small request bodies with function-calling style payloads.
3) Observe increased 502/503 responses from API gateway and runtime logs showing ProtocolException / unexpected frame sequences followed by runtime exit.
4) Reproduced reliably in a staging dedicated cluster when gateway forced connection reuse + midstream TLS session resumption under load.
logs: api-gateway: connection_reset_count=412 over 3h; average upstream latency 42ms; 502 ratio 8.3%
runtime stderr: AssertionError at request_parser.cc:148 - unexpected frame type on reused connection; dumping headers: x-forwarded-proto=HTTP/1.1, upgrade: h2c
system logs: TLS handshake resumption mismatch, ssl_alert 40 (handshake_failure) seen preceding some restarts
dmesg: runtime pid 22341 crashed with SIGABRT; backtrace points to header_parse() -> header_unescape()
investigation_notes: 03/10 09:42 - Support: Confirmed impact for SourceWave, P1 opened. Noted spike coincided with tenant autoscaling event that shifted traffic through a different edge pool.

03/10 10:10 - SRE: Correlated gateway connection reuse metrics with runtime connection errors. Observed pattern when gateway translated HTTP/1.1 keepalive streams into HTTP/2 multiplexed streams to runtime-proxy.

03/10 11:05 - Eng (runtime): Found rare race in request parser when connection had residual h2c upgrade headers on reused sockets; parser could interpret leftover state as a new stream header block, causing assertion and abort.
03/10 11:40 - Temporary mitigation applied: API gateway connection pooling disabled for SourceWave tenant. Error rate dropped to baseline within 6 minutes.
03/10 12:30 - Confirmed no data corruption; crash reproduced in local instrumentation harness by toggling keepalive reuse + simulated partial header injection.
03/11 09:00 - Fix PR authored to add stronger header reset/validation on connection-reuse boundary and remove assumptions about leftover frame state (see PR #4521).
03/11 14:20 - Canary rollout of runtime patch across 3 nodes; monitoring for regressions.
03/12 02:15 - Full rollout completed; gateway pooling re-enabled with new positive validation. No further crashes observed for 24h.
